transfer), built-in HTTP pull data plane,
The participant's did:web DID document, Secure
The dataspace's did:web DID document, DCP
and their status), status lists, management

C4 model, level 2. Each participant runs the connector and the identity; its dataspace authority runs one issuer for all participants (other participants' identities use it the same way). The website is not part of it.
